questions.question: Was renal function (creatinine/eGFR) documented before apixaban was started, and what were the prior values?
For how long has apixaban been prescribed, and was the dose ever adjusted for age, weight or renal function?
Is there a documented indication for apixaban (e.g. atrial fibrillation, VTE), and has bleeding risk been assessed?
Has the rising creatinine (140 umol/L) been reviewed, and were earlier creatinine values lower?
Are there earlier entries recording falls, bleeding or anaemia that would affect anticoagulation safety?
Were any other anticoagulants or interacting medications discontinued before apixaban started?
